title: Threadify Unslop
summary: Score your last 90 days of Threads posts for slop (corporate voice, AI tells, hedging, over-formatting), show raw vs polished median views on your account with the worst offenders quoted, then have Threadify write three raw posts that pass a zero-hedge gate, each with a tracked Auto Plug, and schedule them only after one exact approval.
triggers: which of my posts sound like slop

inputs.name: connected account and 90 days of post performance, or 5-20 pasted posts or drafts, and a saved offer

outputs.name: slop verdict, offenders, gate results, approval packet and schedule receipt

free_capabilities: deterministic slop score on four families with hedging weighted highest and every flagged phrase quoted
raw vs polished median views labelled on your account
zero-hedge gate that prints PASS or FAIL with the matched phrases
pasted-post scoring with no view comparison
local casing guard that proves lower(original) == lower(final) for every post and plug
paid_capability_stubs: post performance history depends on the plan's analytics window
Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
Auto Plug replies need a plan that includes Auto Plug

must_show: join count with its source and date, or why the line was dropped

instructions: Never write or edit posts or plugs yourself; Threadify generates every word and the only permitted change is lowercasing proved by the casing guard.
When a post fails the zero-hedge gate three times, hold it with its reasons and never schedule it.
When the casing guard fails, present Threadify's original text unchanged.
When the offer is not free to try or the join count has no verified, dated source, ask the owner for the number or drop the free-to-try line; never invent or round up the number.
With zero posts in the window or no Threadify connection, score 5-20 pasted posts or drafts, label them as having no view comparison and say how to connect Threadify.
When a number is not returned, show it as unknown, never 0.
When polished posts beat raw posts on the account, report that result.

must_prove: slop scores, flagged phrases and verdict label
plug briefs and join count sources
scheduled posts, slots and Auto Plug echo
